title: Building Better Digital Experiences: A Swyft Media CMS Test Story
body:
Welcome to the Swyft Media Business Stories publishing test.

At Swyft Media, digital experiences bring together creative thinking, technology, and clear communication. This test story has been created to verify that the CMS can accept article content, save it, and display it correctly on the website.

The publishing workflow should allow an authorized administrator to create a story, preview its content, publish it, and confirm that the article appears on the Business Stories listing page.
